cim: Rockwell Automation to Acquire AGILOX to Accelerate AI Strategy
cim_eredeti: Rockwell Automation to Acquire AGILOX to Accelerate AI Strategy
szoveg_eredeti:
The acquisition is expected to more than double Rockwell’s autonomous mobile robots business.

Rockwell Automation today announced a signed definitive agreement to acquire AGILOX, an Austria-based maker of high-end autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) driven by self-developed artificial intelligence and swarm networking technology. Rockwell hopes to create a comprehensive autonomous material movement offering by combining AGILOX's forklift AMR portfolio with its OTTO flatbed AMR platform.

The acquisition will combine OTTO's presence in North America with AGILOX's European footprint. AGILOX will also gain access to Rockwell's relationships in verticals like consumer packaged goods and life sciences. The acquisition is expected to more than double Rockwell’s AMR business.

Material movement is a critical part of manufacturing and warehouse operations. The acquisition supports Rockwell's vision of a production logistics capability that helps customers move from automation to autonomy by addressing material movement across the entire plant floor.

The transaction is subject to closing conditions and regulatory approval and is expected to close in Q2 of Rockwell’s fiscal year 2027. AGILOX will report to Rockwell’s Intelligent Devices operating segment.
